%ezimage.l10n.comment: EzImage English source strings. This file is the fallback language
and is required by vsce — every other bundle must define the same keys.
Run `npm run verify` to check key parity across bundles.
Each value uses {0}, {1}, ... placeholders for runtime interpolation.

sharp.notInstalled.title: EzImage: intelligent compression engine (sharp) is not installed, so WebP conversion and image compression are unavailable. Install it now?
sharp.installFailed.title: EzImage: sharp installation failed. The image will be uploaded as-is. See Output > EzImage for details.
sharp.notInstalled.dismissConfirmed: Auto-install has been turned off. You can re-enable it via `ezimage.autoInstallSharp` in settings.
sharp.notInstalled.abiMismatch.title: EzImage: sharp is installed but failed to load (likely an Electron/Node ABI mismatch). The image will be uploaded as-is. See Output > EzImage for details.
sharp.reloadAfterInstall.title: EzImage: sharp installed successfully. Reload the window to activate it.
log.compressionWillFallback: EzImage will fall back to uploading the original image until sharp is installed.
log.compressionFallbackHint: To fix: trigger an upload — you will be offered an auto-install, or run `npm install sharp` in the extension folder.
log.sharpInstallTimeout: npm install timed out after 5 minutes. Aborting.
log.sharpInstallNpmMissing: Could not find npm on PATH. Please install Node.js (>= 18.17) which includes npm, then click "Install sharp".
log.sharpInstallPermissionHint: Hint: file permission error. Check that the extension folder is writable, or run "Reload Window" and retry.
log.sharpInstallNetworkHint: Hint: cannot reach the npm registry. Check your network or proxy settings.
log.sharpInstallProxyHint: Hint: the npm registry rejected the package. This usually means a corporate proxy intercepted the request — try setting NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY explicitly.
log.sharpInstallSucceeded: sharp installed successfully. User must reload the window for it to take effect.
log.nodeVersionPrompt: Check that `npm --version` works in your shell, then retry.
